description: Source code for mod_authn_dbi, a backend module for authentication using the DBI interface in the lighttpd web server. Implements database connection setup, error handling, and authentication query functions.

methods.name: mod_authn_dbi_error_callback
methods.description: Handles database connection errors and attempts to reconnect up to three times.

methods.name: mod_authn_dbi_dbconf_free
methods.description: Frees and cleans up database configuration and connection resources.

methods.name: mod_authn_dbi_dbconf_setup
methods.description: Sets up database connection and configuration based on provided options.

methods.name: mod_authn_dbi_query_build
methods.description: Constructs SQL query with proper escaping based on authentication info.

methods.name: mod_authn_dbi_query
methods.description: Executes the SQL query to authenticate user and processes the result.

methods.name: mod_authn_dbi_basic
methods.description: Handles Basic HTTP authentication by querying the database.

methods.name: mod_authn_dbi_digest
methods.description: Handles Digest HTTP authentication by querying the database.

methods.name: mod_authn_dbi_init
methods.description: Initializes the plugin and registers the backend.

methods.name: mod_authn_dbi_cleanup
methods.description: Cleans up plugin resources on shutdown.

methods.name: mod_authn_dbi_merge_config_cpv
methods.description: Merges configuration plugin values into plugin config.

methods.name: mod_authn_dbi_patch_config
methods.description: Applies configuration patches based on request conditions.

methods.name: mod_authn_dbi_set_defaults
methods.description: Sets default configuration for the plugin.
